relationships.subject: HSV-1 dsDNA
relationships.evidence_quote: Our research shows that cytosolic double-stranded DNA (dsDNA) from viruses, like herpes simplex virus 1 (HSV-1), triggers pain responses through STING expression in nociceptors.

relationships.subject: STING
relationships.evidence_quote: Notably, these responses involve the direct activation of STING in nociceptors through TRPV1.

relationships.subject: STING
relationships.evidence_quote: We also provided a proof-of-concept showing that STING and TRPV1 significantly contribute to the mechanical hypersensitivity induced by HSV-1 infection.

key_findings: Viral dsDNA such as HSV-1 triggers pain via STING in nociceptors
STING agonists elicit pain through TRPV1; STING and TRPV1 contribute to HSV-1-induced mechanical hypersensitivity
